", "source_child_index": 4099}, {"id": "fr42c-046-0084", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "« Eh bien ? Paganel, dit Glenarvan.", "sha256": "31054c427f667b7a72b7e5c62a9254c31c75beed4d86f9731f9f8b458c29f7a1", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 4100}, {"id": "fr42c-046-0085", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Ah ! fit le géographe, en poussant un cri.", "sha256": "8ae0c77be5f70fdae6e3f14301128b9ecb9a2ba1f4ddd006420bbc2e23da0be1", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 4105}, {"id": "fr42c-046-0090", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "Lady Helena, Mary, Robert, Glenarvan, le regardaient sans rien comprendre à cette inexplicable agitation.", "sha256": "f1fb25b16db43b3dbc6a8f3abe46937b5efe3638573ef6afbbe8b408e2ffe21a", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 4107}, {"id": "fr42c-046-0092", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "Glenarvan reprit la dictée de sa lettre, qui fut définitivement libellée en ces termes :", "sha256": "1bd19d769c90e36ba3c40bed891b5f015301f1cf0e2e86c2246feb73afbe208e", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 4108}, {"id": "fr42c-046-0093", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "« Ordre à Tom Austin de prendre la mer sans retard et de conduire le Duncan par trente-sept degrés de latitude à la côte orientale de l’Australie… »", "sha256": "6e68b20459c795e6fb8f4253e3e556dfe88a3ed66e539b3000f2086c57fe227e", "source_html": "
